title: Panipat
desc: Sadashiv Rao Bhau leads a historic battle against Ahmad Shah Abdali. Duty, honour, and betrayal take centre stage in this grand retelling of the 1761 Panipat war.

title: Pelli SandaD
desc: Srikanth falls in love with Swapna not knowing that she is the sister of the girl he is actually supposed to marry. When Swapna finds out, she backs out for the sake of her sister's happiness.

title: No.1 Dilwala
desc: Two friends share a close bond. A new girl arrives, changing their lives. Their friendship faces challenges and transformations with her presence. How will they adapt?

title: Legend The Terror
desc: A battle of survival where a brave hero faces ruthless enemies, standing strong with courage and resilience in a terrifying fight against destruction.

title: Vicky Vidya Ka Woh Wala Video
desc: A newly married couple's relationship and reputation are put at risk when their CD is stolen. The story follows their roller coaster journey to recover the CD.

title: Sabse Bada Don

title: Maha

title: Vanangaan
desc: A vigilante with hearing loss fights injustice in his own way, but faces punishment from the law for crimes committed while trying to right society's wrongs.
